blocks.value: Once you start placing orders, your trading app will show different sections such as Orders, Holdings and Positions. Understanding these sections is essential.

Imagine This: Think of your school bag. One pocket contains homework, another contains completed assignments, and another holds books you are currently reading. Your trading app organizes your investments in a similar way.
The Order Book shows orders you've placed. Holdings display investments you currently own. Positions show trades that are still active for the day.
If you buy Infosys for long-term investing, it appears in Holdings. If you're doing intraday trading, it appears in Positions until the trade is completed.
Don't confuse Holdings with Positions. Holdings are long-term investments, while Positions usually represent active trades.
